svg.aria-label: Sync search on a real slot
svg.title: Sync search on a real slot
svg.text: Stage 2, the Sync Search, on a real slot (websdr_test6: 27 messages)
A · What the band looks like: average spectrum of the slot
B · What the Sync Search sees: the best Costas score at each frequency (log scale, 1 = background)
Each red peak is a place where the 3 1 4 0 6 5 2 pattern lines up. Triangles mark where messages were finally decoded: green in pass 1 (21), orange only after
subtraction in pass 2 (6). The search keeps up to 400 candidates; of those, 54 survive the Demodulator's sync check in pass 1, and the LDPC sorts out the rest.
